bug_semantics: Untrusted input reaches the runtime-emitted DynamicUnionResolver deserializer for a Union-decorated interface or abstract type. The generated code reads the two-element union array and key, then either recursively invokes the selected subtype formatter or sends an unknown-key value to MessagePackReader.Skip. Before the fix, the union frame never called MessagePackSecurity.DepthStep and never decremented reader.Depth, so union nesting was not charged to MaximumObjectGraphDepth; the unknown-key sink also enters MessagePackReader.TrySkip's recursive array/map traversal outside that accounting scope, permitting configured depth-limit bypass and potential StackOverflowException.
flaw_origin: Commit 700058579a35ef8a7efdff598e5daf618a74166f is the smallest public first-writer: it changed the generated DynamicUnionResolver Serialize and Deserialize methods from NotImplemented placeholders into active union code and introduced recursive subtype deserialization plus unknown-value skipping without depth accounting. Its immediate parent 786844d909141cd0e48d53f0bc722db1c2e54bb2 contains only throwing generated methods and a commented, uncalled draft implementation.
